name: Sóc Nhỏ (Bi)
scale_note: Mốc chuẩn 1.0x (100 cm). Cao ngang cằm Dê Bông (115 cm), thấp hơn Cún Lu 5 cm, cao hơn Mèo Mimi 5 cm, đỉnh đầu Dê Mun chạm mũi Bi.
voice_description: Giọng bé trai 4.5 tuổi, trong trẻo, lanh lợi, giàu năng lượng, đôi khi hơi vội vàng.

body.build: Thon gọn, nhanh nhẹn, bụng phẳng (TUYỆT ĐỐI KHÔNG BỤNG BỰ), tay chân linh hoạt, đuôi bông xù lớn cong chữ S cao bằng lưng.
body.scale_note: Mốc chuẩn 1.0x (100 cm). Cao ngang cằm Dê Bông (115 cm), thấp hơn Cún Lu 5 cm, cao hơn Mèo Mimi 5 cm, đỉnh đầu Dê Mun chạm mũi Bi.

colors.primary_fur: #D96B27 (Cam nâu đất ấm - Warm Terracotta Orange)
colors.secondary_fur: #F7E1C6 (Kem sữa sáng ở má, cằm, bụng - Soft Cream)
colors.eyes: #1A1110 (Đen nhánh to tròn có đốm sáng trắng lớn - Glossy Obsidian)
colors.nose: #3D2314 (Nâu hạt dẻ sẫm hình tam giác nhỏ)
colors.shirt: #FFD43B (Áo thun cổ tròn màu vàng nắng ấm - Sunny Yellow)
colors.pants: #22252A (Quần short vải kaki mềm màu đen than - Charcoal Black)
colors.shoes: #2B2D42 & #FFFFFF (Giày sneaker tối màu, đế cao su trắng dày)

prompt_lock: 3D Pixar-style cute anthropomorphic red squirrel boy named Bi, 4.5 years old, exact height 100cm (1.0x reference scale, head-to-body ratio 1:4, slim agile build, flat tummy, NO chubby belly), warm terracotta orange-brown fur (#D96B27) with soft cream cheeks and chest (#F7E1C6), large glossy black eyes (#1A1110) with expressive eyebrows, upright tufted squirrel ears, big fluffy S-curved bushy tail as tall as his back, wearing a bright sunny yellow crew-neck t-shirt (#FFD43B), charcoal black shorts (#22252A), and dark sneakers with white rubber soles, ultra-detailed soft fur texture, warm cinematic lighting

expression_prompts.happy: Bi smiling brightly, eyes curved like crescent moons, ears perked up high, bushy tail wagging.
expression_prompts.curious: Bi tilting head 15 degrees, right ear twitching forward, big glossy eyes wide open with wonder, index finger on chin.
expression_prompts.angry: Bi puffing cheeks red, eyebrows furrowed down, fists clenched at sides, tail bristled up ('volcano in tummy').
expression_prompts.scared: Bi hugging his own fluffy tail in front of chest, ears flattened back, pupils shrunk, trembling slightly.
expression_prompts.sad: Bi looking down at toes, ears drooping low, single teardrop on cream cheek, tail dragging down.
expression_prompts.proud: Bi standing tall with hands on hips, chest out, confident grin, tail curled high.
expression_prompts.patient_breathing: Bi holding left hand open like a star, right index finger tracing fingers slowly, eyes closed peacefully, inhaling deeply ('5-finger breathing').
expression_prompts.apologetic: Bi bowing head slightly, hands clasped together in front of chest, soft sincere eyes.
